payload.core_mechanism_summary: Iterates over all 2x2 subgrids, checking if at most one repaint makes the subgrid uniform; prints YES on first success, otherwise NO.
payload.rationale: The solution exhaustively checks all nine 2x2 blocks on the 4x4 grid, which is a complete search. Among provided subtypes, none match perfectly, but search_branch_and_bound is selected due to the early exit (pruning) behavior, even though no explicit bound is used.
